brief: A contacts app as a social constellation — closeness reflects relationship, interactions glow

dominant_strengths: Constellation metaphor is genuinely fresh — orbital placement and glow encode closeness and recency without explicit labels
Color-coded avatars double as identity tokens in both list and graph, creating a strong cross-view memory anchor
Detail card uses confident hierarchy with vivid metric numerals, giving the right reflective payoff on selection
dominant_weaknesses: The constellation lacks legible structure — connection lines are barely visible, so 'closeness' reads as random scatter rather than a system
Sidebar list and spatial graph duplicate the same data without differentiated affordance; the list feels like a fallback, not a complement
Empty dark canvas dominates; nodes float without rings, clusters, or category zones to scaffold meaning at a glance
fix_priorities: Introduce concentric proximity rings or category sectors so distance-from-ME encodes relationship strength visually
Strengthen edges with weighted, glowing lines tied to interaction frequency to deliver on the 'interactions glow' promise
Differentiate the sidebar — make it filters/groups rather than a redundant list, reclaiming the metaphor as primary
Tighten typography scale in the detail card; 47/12/3d/89% compete equally and need a clearer primary metric
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral and reflective lead through the striking metaphor and metric card, while behavioral usability lags because the spatial layer lacks readable rules.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes — the constellation concept directly expresses the brief, but execution under-delivers on encoding closeness and interaction glow as legible signals.
